title: Well-formedness after the De Morgan transformation
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose every gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. Then every gate in the circuit obtained by the De Morgan transformation also has distinct arguments, and each of its NOT gates has exactly one argument.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
